items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Johnson and I never played together during my time in Europe, although we played together in the very early years at the dance palaces in New York.

ctx.x: You know, there was usually just a small group, you know, maybe 4 or 5 pieces -- sometimes just a trio, or maybe a trio even, you know? I remember playing a job where I think there was Freddie Johnson on piano, Walter Johnson, who was with Fletcher in later years, on the drums --and me. Just the three pieces. And we just played, you know, a chorus of the current tunes, and ...
Right. And by 'current tunes', you mean the Tin Pan Alley tunes?
